week_thesis: NFP 'good news is bad news' triggered Nasdaq -4.2% selloff on June 5 as 172K nonfarm payrolls (2x consensus) spiked the 10-year Treasury yield to 4.54% and raised Fed rate-hike probability to 57%. AI/semi fundamentals remain unimpaired: AMD Q1 data center revenue $5.8B (+57% YoY) with Q2 guidance raised to $11.2B (+46%), NVIDIA-LG Group humanoid robot + advanced data center architecture partnership announced June 8, AVGO Q2 beat confirmed AI infrastructure super-cycle. June 5 dip (NVDA -6.2% to $205.10, AMD -10.86% to ~$387) is macro-driven, not fundamental deterioration — creating a textbook mean-reversion entry into the two highest-conviction AI hardware names. Consolidate: close PLTR (barely above $135.14 entry, rate-sensitive ultra-high-PE, June forecast -10.4%), VECO (near stop, minimal conviction), VIAV (analyst target below entry), ACLS (near stop, thesis replicated by AMAT). Add NVDA (62-analyst Strong Buy, $298-311 avg target = +45-51% upside) and AMD (#1 universe RS60 scorer, Q2 guidance raised). Portfolio enters week ~$100,907 after -10.3% June 5 drawdown; consolidating 4 positions frees ~$60K buying power for 2 high-conviction adds.
